event.title: Taco Tuesday
event.description: Taco Tuesday at V’s Cellar Taco Tuesday is back and better than ever! 🌮 Every Tuesday, we’re serving up our signature tacos, each bursting with bold, fresh flavors. Whether you’re craving our Al Pastor, the sweet & savory kick of Bulgogi Steak, the spicy tang of Korean Chicken, or the zest of Vegan Asian Ginger, we’ve got something for everyone. Plus, every taco is $1 off all day long! Taco Tuesday is the perfect excuse to enjoy tacos for lunch, dinner, or a snack in between. Come indulge in your favorite fusion taco creations, and don’t forget: each week brings a new reason to come back for more! Whether you’re a Taco Tuesday regular or it’s your first time, we guarantee you’ll find something you love. Mark your calendars, grab your friends, and make your Tuesday a little tastier with us! #TacoTuesday #VeganTacos #VsCellar #FusionFlavors #JuneauEats

Whether you’re craving our Al Pastor, the sweet & savory kick of Bulgogi Steak, the spicy tang of Korean Chicken, or the zest of Vegan Asian Ginger, we’ve got something for everyone. Plus, every taco is $1 off all day long! Taco Tuesday is the perfect excuse to enjoy tacos for lunch, dinner, or a snack in between. Come indulge in your favorite fusion taco creations, and don’t forget: each week brings a new reason to come back for more! Whether you’re a Taco Tuesday regular or it’s your first time, we guarantee you’ll find something you love. Mark your calendars, grab your friends, and make your Tuesday a little tastier with us! #TacoTuesday #VeganTacos #VsCellar #FusionFlavors #JuneauEats

Whether you’re craving our Al Pastor, the sweet & savory kick of Bulgogi Steak, the spicy tang of Korean Chicken, or the zest of Vegan Asian Ginger, we’ve got something for everyone. Plus, every taco is $1 off all day long! Taco Tuesday is the perfect excuse to enjoy tacos for lunch, dinner, or a snack in between. Come indulge in your favorite fusion taco creations, and don’t forget: each week brings a new reason to come back for more! Whether you’re a Taco Tuesday regular or it’s your first time, we guarantee you’ll find something you love. Mark your calendars, grab your friends, and make your Tuesday a little tastier with us! #TacoTuesday #VeganTacos #VsCellar #FusionFlavors #JuneauEats

Whether you’re craving our Al Pastor, the sweet & savory kick of Bulgogi Steak, the spicy tang of Korean Chicken, or the zest of Vegan Asian Ginger, we’ve got something for everyone. Plus, every taco is $1 off all day long! Taco Tuesday is the perfect excuse to enjoy tacos for lunch, dinner, or a snack in between. Come indulge in your favorite fusion taco creations, and don’t forget: each week brings a new reason to come back for more! Whether you’re a Taco Tuesday regular or it’s your first time, we guarantee you’ll find something you love. Mark your calendars, grab your friends, and make your Tuesday a little tastier with us! #TacoTuesday #VeganTacos #VsCellar #FusionFlavors #JuneauEats
